name: fake-data-generator
title: Fake Data Generator
description: Generate checksum-valid fake IBANs, BICs, VAT numbers, EINs, ABNs, IRD numbers, names, emails, phone numbers and companies for testing. One keystroke to copy.
author: joachim_bauters

commands.name: generate-iban
commands.title: Generate IBAN
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: Checksum-valid IBANs for 50 European countries, incl. national check digits and matching BIC.

commands.name: generate-vat
commands.title: Generate VAT Number
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: Valid-format VAT numbers for all EU countries (VIES format), UK, Northern Ireland, Switzerland and Norway.

commands.name: generate-tax-id
commands.title: Generate Tax ID
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: US EIN, Australian ABN / ACN / TFN, New Zealand IRD / GST number and NZBN.

commands.name: generate-financial
commands.title: Generate Financial Data
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: BIC/SWIFT codes, Luhn-valid and Stripe test card numbers, ABA routing numbers, UK sort codes and AU BSBs.

commands.name: generate-phone
commands.title: Generate Phone Number
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: Mobile or landline numbers per country, using regulator-reserved fictional ranges where they exist.

commands.name: generate-person
commands.title: Generate Person
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: Fake name, email, phone, birthdate and address for a country.

commands.name: generate-company
commands.title: Generate Company
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: Fake company with legal form, VAT number, registration number, IBAN, phone, email and address.

commands.name: generate-email
commands.title: Generate Email
commands.subtitle: Fake Data
commands.description: Fake email addresses on reserved domains (example.com, .test) that never reach a real inbox.

preferences.name: copyFormat
preferences.title: Copy Format
preferences.description: What Enter copies. The other format is always available with ⌘⇧C.

preferences.name: phoneMode
preferences.title: Phone Numbers
preferences.description: Fictional ranges never reach a real person, but UK and French mobile drama ranges fail libphonenumber validation.

preferences.name: emailDomain
preferences.title: Email Domain
preferences.description: Domain for generated person emails. Keep a reserved domain (example.com/.org/.net) unless you own the domain.
